title.narrative: Agua Potable y Saneamiento Pequenas Comunidades

description.narrative: THE OBJECTIVE OF THE PROGRAM IS THE IMPROVEMENT OF THE SANITARY CONDITIONS IN RURAL COMMUNITIES THROUGH THE ADEQUATE PROVISION OF WATER SUPPLY AND SANITATION SERVICES. IN ORDER TO ACHIEVE THIS, THE PROGRAM WILL FINANCE THE CONSTRUCTION OF POTABLE WATER SYSTEMS AND INDIVIDUAL SANITATION FACILITIES IN 100 RURAL COMMUNITIES AND 10 INDIGENOUS COMMUNITIES, AND WILL STRENGTHEN THE JUNTAS DE SANEAMIENTO AND SENASA IN THE PROVISION OF THE SERVICES.
